adjunctor , ōris, m. id.,
I.one who adds, joins, or unites (used only by Cic. in strong indignation): “ille Galliae ulterioris adjunctor, i. e. Pompey, by whose influence Gallia Transalpina was granted to Cæsar, in addition to Gallia Cisalpina,” Cic. Att. 8, 3, 3 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
